instructions.name: migrate_native_custody
docs: Extends a custody opened before `tracked_shares` existed. Permissionless.

accounts.name: custody
docs: longer deserializes; owner, seeds, discriminator and length are checked below.

accounts.name: pool
docs: The canonical sim_lst Pool: owned by the sim_lst program and at its `["pool"]` PDA.

errors.name: DuplicateAccount
errors.msg: the same account was supplied twice

errors.name: InvalidPool
errors.msg: pool is not the canonical sim_lst pool

errors.name: InvalidMint
errors.msg: mint is not the sim_lst pool's simSOL mint

errors.name: NativePosition
errors.msg: native Positions are opened and driven only by the native instructions

errors.name: NotNativePosition
errors.msg: position is not a native Position

errors.name: StalePrice

errors.name: BridgedSource

types.name: Account
docs: One Account's identity ledger. Balances mirror the sum of its Holdings, split by whether the
Gemas are own-sourced (Source owned by this Account) or won (any other Source).

fields.name: own_reserved
docs: Reserved for Offers (part of the totals, not free to enter Matches or redeem).

fields.name: oracle_authority
docs: Trusted for now to supply the issuance price and `YieldAccrued`/`PositionLocked` facts.
This is the seam for the LayerZero receiver (messages) and Pyth (price).

fields.name: platform_recipient
docs: `TesoroAccount` that receives the Platform Fee.

fields.name: game
docs: Identity of the Game (its program id).

fields.name: authority
docs: Only this key may settle the Game's Matches (a PDA of the Game program, or a server key).

fields.name: studio_recipient
docs: `TesoroAccount` that receives the Studio Fee.

types.name: Holding
docs: Gemas held by one Account of one Source.

types.name: Line
docs: A slice of Gemas of one Source moving into a Pot or a reservation.

fields.name: fees
docs: Fee terms snapshotted when the Match opened.

fields.name: deadline
docs: After this time anyone may refund the Match as abandoned / no-show.

types.name: NativeCustody
docs: Custody of one native Position: the simSOL vault and what is needed to value it.

fields.name: pool
docs: The `sim_lst` Pool (canonical PDA) whose rate values the vault.

fields.name: vault
docs: Token account (PDA) holding the Position's simSOL, authority = this custody.

fields.name: rate_at_open
docs: sim_lst rate at open (1e9 fixed point, SOL per simSOL).

fields.name: deposited_shares
docs: simSOL deposited at open, base units. Informational: the vault balance is authoritative.

fields.name: redeemed_units
docs: SOL base units paid to Gema holders from the vault by `redeem`.

fields.name: tracked_shares
docs: Shares this custody accounts for: deposited at open minus paid out. Yield and cover are read
from this, never from the vault's token balance, so simSOL sent straight to the vault is not
yield (ADR 0001: Principal never pays Debt, not even by top-up). Appended after the original
layout; custodies opened before it are extended by `migrate_native_custody`.

fields.name: last_accrual_ts
docs: Unix time up to which yield has been minted into the vault (per-Position yield model,
docs/yield-model.md). Appended after `tracked_shares`; older custodies are extended by
`migrate_native_custody`, which starts it at the migration time.

types.name: NativePayout
docs: simSOL paid out of a Position's vault.

fields.name: kind
docs: 0 = redeem, 1 = unlock, 2 = sweep.

fields.name: player_share_bps
docs: Player's share of the surplus, basis points. The Backer's max loss is `entry`.

fields.name: expires_at
docs: Acceptance deadline for an Open Offer.

fields.name: use_by
docs: Deadline to enter a Match once Accepted.

fields.name: applicants
docs: Request keys of applicants (public Offers).

fields.name: lines
docs: The Backer's reserved Gemas.

fields.name: base_rate
docs: Rate at `base_ts`, 1e9 fixed point (SOL per simSOL).

fields.name: speedup
docs: Yield-clock multiplier; 4,320 = 1 month of yield per 10 minutes.

types.name: Position
docs: A staker's locked, yield-bearing stake. `principal` is recorded but no function of this core
ever reads it except to size a new Advance, and none lets it reduce Debt.

fields.name: owner
docs: Account identity that owns the Position.

fields.name: principal
docs: Principal in source-asset base units.

fields.name: rate_bps
docs: Provider annual rate in basis points, fixed at open.

fields.name: advances
docs: Advances taken so far; also the index of the next Source.

fields.name: open_advance
docs: Index of the open Advance (the Source with Debt), if any.

fields.name: last_seq
docs: Highest cross-chain message sequence applied.

fields.name: cumulative_yield
docs: Last cumulative accrued yield applied, source-asset units.

fields.name: free_yield
docs: Yield accrued while no Advance had Debt to repay; belongs to the owner.

types.name: PositionUnlocked
docs: The seam for the `Unlock` message.

types.name: PriceFeed
docs: SOL/USD price used for issuance (micro-USD per whole SOL). Written by the oracle authority
for devnet; the Pyth seam replaces this account's source, not `take_native_advance`.

types.name: Redeemed
docs: The seam for `PayYield`: source-chain units owed to the redeeming Account's address there.

types.name: Request
docs: A Player's listing asking to be backed for a game and entry size. Carries no split.

types.name: ReservedLine
docs: Reservation of a Backer's Gemas for an Offer; `is_own` keeps the own-first classes intact.

types.name: Side
docs: One entrant. `funder == player` unless the entry is backed; then `share_bps` is the Player's
share of the surplus from the accepted Offer.

types.name: Source
docs: The Advance a Gema was issued from.

fields.name: owner
docs: Owner of the Position at issuance; Gemas of this Source are "own-sourced" for them.

fields.name: unit_num
docs: Source-asset base units per Gema is `unit_num / unit_den`.

fields.name: yield_units
docs: Accrued yield applied to this Source, source-asset units.

fields.name: redeemed_units
docs: Source-asset units already paid out by Redeem.

types.name: SourceAuthority
docs: The signer allowed to report `PositionLocked` / `YieldAccrued` for Positions of one source
chain (the cross-chain bridge PDA). Registered by the admin; seeds `["source_auth", chain_byte]`.

fields.name: authority
docs: Solana wallet that controls the Account.

fields.name: evm_address
docs: The EVM family address of the Account (zero until set).

types.name: YieldConfig
docs: The authority allowed to mint simulated yield.
